about_the_game:
Design and optimize your own object factory as you transform primitive shapes into advanced 3D objects. Start with Sphere, Cube, Pyramid, and Cylinder, then combine them through production chains to meet stage goals or create what you want as you progress into the creative mode. Balance efficiency, time, and resources to master the art of factory design.

Features:

  • 🏭 Factory-Building Gameplay: Place machines and conveyors to transform basic shapes into complex 3D objects.

  • 🔄 Strategic Workflow: Optimize layouts and adapt to restrictions.

  • 🎲 Game Modes: Stage-based progression with goals to progress to the endless Creative Mode.

  • 🧩 Procedural Levels: Unique challenges every time.

  • ✂️ Shape Manipulation: Cut spheres, cubes, pyramids, and cylinders into smaller parts and recombine.

  • 🌱 Small Tech Tree: Unlock new machines and production perks as you progress.

A casual minimalistic sandbox factory-building game about transforming primitive shapes into complex 3D objects with a balance of simplicity and depth. Start with the four basic forms – Sphere, Cube, Pyramid, and Cylinder – and combine them through production chains to create more advanced objects and send them to the portal. 

Design efficient layouts, optimize your workflow, and balance time and resources to keep your factory running smoothly and complete the stage. Every decision matters: Build and expand your production chains or remove, reuse or rebuild your line to complete different goal shapes. Manage efficiency and pacing through careful balancing. Unlock new possibilities as your factory grows. Use the given tools and adapt to the constraints and circumstances. The machines or conveyors might not have the layout you would like but the mastery lies in using what you got and adapt to the circumstances.

The goal is simple, but the path to mastery lies in how well you can turn the simplest shapes into something extraordinary overcoming the imposed restrictions with the tools given.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04, Ubuntu 24.04
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+, Vulkan capable GPUs
  • Additional Notes: Gnome desktop environment running on top of X11 or Wayland windowing system. Other configuration and user environment as provided stock with the supported distribution (such as Kernel or Compositor) Nvidia and AMD GPUs using Nvidia official proprietary graphics driver, or AMD Mesa graphics driver.
